notes: Converted from MAME's src/mame/cinematronics/nl_tailg.cpp (NETLIST_START(tailg), CC0-1.0, Aaron Giles) at mame0289 by tools/mame_netlist.py. Every change from MAME's file -- the simulation stand-ins undone, the hacks dropped, the corrections from the sheet -- is logged at the top of boards/tailg-sound.nets.

Two MAME changes are undone by their switches: the diodes D8/D9 on the 74LS123's Rext/Cext pins are back (MAME snips them for speed), and the pull-ups MAME adds to the 74LS125 outputs are gone. The hyperspace VCO's real circuit uses Q1, which MAME declares only in a comment ('not used' -- by the stand-in); the declaration is restored.

Compared with sheet 1 of the audio board, Schematic Audio Board - Tailgunner SD205202 (doc 22a6fb78dd5a p55, 600 dpi), and the parts list PL205202 (pp41-43), 2026-10-20: the trigger port IC23 with its J4 inputs (O0-O4 on J4-11 to J4-15) and its six used outputs; the noise generator (D1, IC1-IC3, but see below); the explosion (IC9, IC10, IC12, Q3), rumble (IC6, Q4) and shield (IC4, Q5, IC13, the 555s IC16 and IC17 with their RC ladders); the shield bounce (IC14, IC15, IC18, IC12, Q8, IC22); the hyperspace and laser VCOs (IC7/Q1, IC11/Q2) with the 74LS393 IC8 and its taps R17-R20 and R35-R38; and the summing line into R70 all agree with MAME pin for pin and value for value, diode and transistor orientation included, and every value MAME has (R1-R70, R76-R84, C1-C33, C41-C44) agrees with the parts list. The three MAME changes this file undoes are what the sheet draws: D8 and D9 on the 74LS123's pins 15 and 7, no pull-ups on the 74LS125 outputs (pins 3 and 6), and the hyperspace VCO built from IC7 and Q1 into IC5 pin 1. Corrected from the sheet: IC23 pin 11 (Q6), which MAME leaves unconnected, goes to J3-9 "TO START BUTTON LIGHT"; and R70 goes into IC19 pin 2, the final amplifier's inverting input, rather than to ground, with IC19 pin 3 grounded (MAME lines 670 and 676).

Slips in the parts list that change nothing here: item 32 gives R22 as 22K (R22 is 1K on the sheet and in item 24; the 22K is the final amplifier's R72), and items 14 and 18 garble C45-C49. The theory text says Q5 for the rumble transistor (the sheet: Q4) and Q1 for the laser squarer (Q2). IC1's printed type is unreadable on this scan; the parts list gives TL081. Not in this file: sheet 2 (p65, the joystick circuitry on the same board, IC24-IC28), and the final amplifier and regulators (R71-R75, C34-C40, Q6, Q7, IC20, IC21), whose values agree with MAME's commented-out lines.
conflicts: The sheet draws the noise amplifier IC1 with C3/R2 on pin 2 (-) and R4/C4 on pin 3 (+), and MAME copies it (its lines 325 and 328, in the branch it never runs). As drawn R4 is positive feedback and the op-amp would latch; the manual's own text (p24) gives IC1 a gain of 1000, which is 1 + R4/R3 only with R4 on the inverting input; and Sundance's sheet SD203200, the same circuit by the same drafter, draws C3 into pin 3 and the feedback into pin 2. This file follows the sheet. Not checked against a board.
